problem.description: Username field cannot be edited when editing a user in the user management interface

visual_symptoms.symptom: Username field has gray background indicating readonly/disabled state
Lock icon (🔒) displayed next to username field
User cannot click or type in the username field

root_cause.decision: Username field was intentionally made readonly during editing for security reasons
root_cause.rationale: To prevent accidental login credential changes

required_change.requirement: Make username field editable during user editing
required_change.specific_change: Remove or set readonly=false for username field

considerations.consideration: This reverses the security decision from v3.8.1
Need to ensure username uniqueness validation on backend
Should warn users about changing login credentials

technical_context.input_component: Custom Input component with readonly prop support

related_fixes.fix: Input component readonly styling with lock icon
Fixed email and password fields incorrectly appearing as readonly
